{{Top|leg}}
'''Gene Corp''' was a company that had relations with the [[Bleeder]]s, a gang of organ harvesters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Kaeden Ta'kor]] served as the liaison between the Bleeders and Gene Corp.
